name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you show skill in Alchemy. The well draws healers and spellcasters to a camp for refreshment.

sections.title: A Camp for Alchemists
sections.body: An Alchemist can learn to make a Mana Well from Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village, once you have shown proficiency in your skill. Healers and spellcasters are drawn to its refreshing drink. To try it at camp, you need a campfire first; a cook can teach you how to make one.

faq.answer: Nyassa Swiftdraught in Shen'dar Village can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you have shown proficiency in Alchemy.

faq.q: What does a Mana Well do?
faq.answer: A Mana Well draws healers and spellcasters to your camp for a refreshing drink.

faq.q: Where do I learn to make a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Nyassa Swiftdraught teaches the recipe in Shen'dar Village.

faq.q: What do I need before setting up camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire to start your camp. A cook can teach you to make one.

angles.text: A cook can teach you to make the campfire needed to start your camp.
